req.title: Redirect-to supports custom status codes
req.statement: The system shall honour the 'status_code' query parameter on /redirect-to for values 301, 302, 303, 307, and 308.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /redirect-to endpoint should support custom status codes for redirection. The test suite will verify that the endpoint correctly handles valid status codes, rejects invalid ones, and properly processes boundary values.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_valid_status_code
preconditions: The httpbin app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with a valid status_code of 301 and a valid URL.
expected: The response status code should be 301.
The Location header should match the provided URL.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=301')
assert response.status_code == 301
assert response.headers['Location'] == b'http://example.com'

tests.name: test_redirect_to_invalid_status_code
preconditions: The httpbin app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with an invalid status_code of 400 and a valid URL.
expected: The response status code should be 302, as the invalid status code should be ignored.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=400')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == b'http://example.com'

tests.name: test_redirect_to_boundary_status_code
preconditions: The httpbin app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with a boundary status_code of 300 and a valid URL.
expected: The response status code should be 302, as 300 is not a valid redirect status code.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=300')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == b'http://example.com'
